question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Honest
solution:
The correct answer is: **Corrupt**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word '**honest**' means truthful and sincere. (सच्चा और ईमानदार)

 
 
• **Example**: *She is known for her honesty and integrity, always speaking the truth and doing what is right.*
 
 
 
• The antonym of 'honest' is '**corrupt**', which means dishonest and unethical. (बेईमान और अनैतिक)
 
 
• **Example**: *The corrupt officials embezzled public funds for their personal gain, betraying the trust of the people they were supposed to serve.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Frank **means open and straightforward. (खुला और सीधा)
 
• **Open **means transparent and accessible. (पारदर्शी और सुलभ)
 
• **Foolish **This means silly and unwise. (मूर्ख और नासमझ)
